name: test_sync_tool
description: Internal synchronization helper used by Codex integration tests.

sleep_before_ms.description: Optional delay in milliseconds before any other action

sleep_after_ms.description: Optional delay in milliseconds after completing the barrier

id.description: Identifier shared by concurrent calls that should rendezvous

participants.description: Number of tool calls that must arrive before the barrier opens

timeout_ms.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait at the barrier
